title: bug: scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs throws at import at the tip ("missing boundaries:     MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false"), because 3586957f (task-1ccae85c) rewrote that moe-agent.sh line as `MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false; VM_TASKLESS_SKIP=false`, so none of its 58 bash and PowerShell seat re-registration cases run and CI's "Test launcher daemon.json cap and seat re-registration" step is red on Linux and Windows
description:
Filed by hunt #20 (task-9f3eac6d, a CI dry run of moe/work-2026-10-24 at bc4793cf).

PROBLEM
- seat-registration.test.mjs builds `SEGMENTS` (:80-101) at module top. Each entry is a real launcher slice, cut between two boundary strings by `between()` (:18-23), which asserts that both boundaries exist.
- The sh `decide` slice (:86) starts at `'    MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false\n'`.
- 3586957f (task-1ccae85c, CQ-M epic, DONE, 2026-11-04 00:29, "Bash VM taskless skip prints a second misleading idle reason") changed that line to `    MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false; VM_TASKLESS_SKIP=false`, which is moe-agent.sh:11185 at bc4793cf.
  - `git show 3586957f^:scripts/moe-agent.sh | grep -c '^    MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false$'` gives 1; at bc4793cf it gives 0.
- So `between` throws during import, node --test reports the whole file as one failed test, and none of its 58 cases run. They include the bash and pwsh 7 rows of the pruned/DEAD idle-seat re-join path (task-8333866a), plus the PowerShell 5.1 rows on Windows.
- 1ccae85c's verification ran only parity-check.sh and postflight-vm-route.sh.
- Every other boundary still matches. I checked all 14 against bc4793cf with a copy that logs misses instead of asserting: only this one is missing. 62ec51f1's WIP branch (80879746) also keeps every ps1 boundary.

EVIDENCE (HEAD bc4793cf, Linux snapshot, pwsh 7.6.9 on PATH, every MOE_* var cleared)
- CI dry run, step "Test launcher daemon.json cap and seat re-registration": exit 1 (tests 111, pass 73, fail 1, skipped 37). Log: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-9f3eac6d/ci/j4/13-daemon-json-cap-seat-reg.log
    AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: missing boundaries:     MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false
     /     if [ "$MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH" != true ] && { [ "$CLI_TYPE" = claude ]
        at between (file:///.../scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs:21:10)
        at file:///.../scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs:86:13
    ✖ scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs (33.596251ms)
      'test failed'
- With only that boundary changed to `'    MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false; VM_TASKLESS_SKIP=false\n'`, the file gives tests 58, pass 38, skipped 19 (PowerShell 5.1, Windows-only).
  - Its single failure, "CI runs this suite on Linux and Windows", is an artifact of the renamed copy.
  - Copies in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-9f3eac6d/seatreg/: seat-registration.segcheck.mjs (the boundary check) and seat-registration.fixed.test.mjs.

FIX DIRECTION
- Test-only. Re-anchor the sh `decide` start boundary on the current line.
- Prefer a boundary that tolerates a trailing statement on that line: the prefix `'    MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false'` with no `\n`. Its first occurrence is line 11185.
- Do the same for the ps1 twin `'    $moeSkipLaunch = $false\n'` (:93). task-1dfec7a4 (CQ-M, BACKLOG, the ps1 twin of 1ccae85c) is likely to make the same edit to that ps1 line.
- Do not change moe-agent.sh or moe-agent.ps1.

FILES: scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs only. Not held by any open row (lanes.js -v at 09:12Z).
PLACEMENT: no dependsOn. task-1dfec7a4's plan should re-run this file; a comment on 1dfec7a4 points here.
definitionOfDone: `node --test scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs` exits 0 in a Linux git-archive snapshot of the fix commit with pwsh 7 on PATH and every MOE_* var unset, reporting at least 38 passing cases with only the PowerShell 5.1 rows skipped.

The row's diff touches neither scripts/moe-agent.sh nor scripts/moe-agent.ps1, and the sh and ps1 `decide` start boundaries still match when that line carries a trailing `; <statement>` (shown by a case or by running the file against a copy with one appended).
The CI step command `node --test scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs scripts/tests/subagent-mirror.test.mjs` exits 0 in that snapshot.

implementationPlan.note: Added DECIDE prefix boundaries, two call sites, and the appended-statement case. Quick loop: 59 tests, 0 fail (pwsh absent so PS7 skipped).

implementationPlan.description:
Run the task's one gate verbatim from the ROOT of your task worktree. It exports HEAD and overlays your uncommitted test edit; at QA time the overlay is a no-op. Run it from the root, because `git archive HEAD` in a subdirectory archives only that subdirectory.
bash -c 'set -euo pipefail; R=$PWD; S=$(mktemp -d /tmp/moe-649f-XXXXXX); echo "snapshot=$S"; git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S"; cp "$R/scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs" "$S/scripts/tests/"; mkdir "$S/pwsh"; tar -xzf /mnt/d/moe-scratch/pwsh/pwsh-7.6.9-linux-x64.tgz -C "$S/pwsh"; chmod +x "$S/pwsh/pwsh"; export PATH="$S/pwsh:$PATH"; unset $(compgen -e | grep "^MOE_" || true); cd "$S"; for p in moe-daemon moe-proxy; do (cd "packages/$p" && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build) > "build-$p.log" 2>&1 || { tail -20 "build-$p.log"; exit 1; }; done; rc=0; node --test --test-reporter=tap scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs > seat.tap || rc=$?; tail -8 seat.tap; [ "$rc" = 0 ]; grep -qx "# fail 0" seat.tap; grep -qx "# skipped 19" seat.tap; grep -Eqx "# pass (3[89]|[4-9][0-9])" seat.tap; node --test scripts/tests/daemon-json-cap.test.mjs scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs scripts/tests/subagent-mirror.test.mjs'
What it does, in order:
- Exports HEAD to a fresh /tmp/moe-649f-* snapshot.
- Puts pwsh 7.6.9 on PATH from /mnt/d/moe-scratch/pwsh/pwsh-7.6.9-linux-x64.tgz. pwsh is not installed in WSL. If that file is gone, copy /tmp/hunt-9f3e/pwsh.tgz to that path; else download PowerShell 7's linux-x64 tar.gz from its GitHub releases to that path. Never apt-install on the shared host.
- Unsets every MOE_* var.
- Builds moe-daemon and moe-proxy inside the snapshot exactly like ci.yml's Build daemon / Build proxy steps. daemon-json-cap's identity and path-contract rows read packages/*/dist; without the build 14 rows fail.
- Runs seat-registration alone under TAP and asserts exit 0, '# fail 0', '# skipped 19' and '# pass' >= 38 (DoD 1). Skipped 19 means only the PowerShell 5.1 rows; without pwsh it would be 38.
- Runs CI's exact step command (DoD 3).
Error handling: the gate fails closed under `set -euo pipefail`.
- A missing pwsh tarball is a tar error, never a silent PS7 skip.
- A failed build prints its log tail and exits 1.
- Every count is grep-checked.
Architect dry runs at acea850b:
- With this edit, 85 s: '# tests 59 / # pass 40 / # fail 0 / # skipped 19', then 'tests 169 / pass 113 / fail 0 / skipped 56', exit 0.
- Unfixed: '# tests 1 / # fail 1', exit 1.
Never run npm in the worktree or the shared checkout (rail). Put the command verbatim, its exit code and the output tail in complete_task's verification. Then delete the snapshot (about 400 MB) by the literal path it printed as snapshot=.

implementationPlan.description:
Adversarial self-review, then complete_task with step 2's evidence.
1. `git status --porcelain` and `git diff --stat` in the worktree name only scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs (DoD 2: no launcher bytes).
2. The diff is exactly the DECIDE block, the two decide call sites and the new case.
3. Mutant proofs, in a mkdtemp dir outside the worktree that holds scripts/moe-agent.sh, scripts/moe-agent.ps1, .github/workflows/ci.yml and the edited test at the same relative paths (shell edits are fine there):
   - Restore \n on the ps1 DECIDE start and run `node --test --test-name-pattern='decide start line' scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs`. Expect 1 fail, 'missing boundaries:     $moeSkipLaunch = $false'.
   - Put `git show HEAD:scripts/tests/seat-registration.test.mjs` there and run it. Expect the import to fail with 'missing boundaries:     MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false'.
4. Think it through:
   - A later `    MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false…` or `    $moeSkipLaunch = $false…` line placed above the decide block would make the prefix pick the wrong line. The count === 1 assertion names that case.
   - Windows CI reads the launchers with CRLF normalized to LF, so the prefixes match the same lines under Git Bash, PS 5.1 and pwsh 7.
5. If anything changed, re-run step 2's command and use the fresh output. Delete your scratch dirs by literal path. Never pattern-kill (shared-host rail).
implementationPlan.note: Self-review: status shows only the test file. Mutants verified: ps1 start with \n restored fails the new case 'missing boundaries: $moeSkipLaunch = $false'; HEAD's old test fails at import with 'missing boundaries: MOE_SKIP_LAUNCH=false'. count===1 guards a duplicate prefix line. Scratch dirs deleted.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Chosen: drop the trailing \n from both decide start strings, so they match as prefixes. This is the smallest change that tolerates a trailing statement, and it is the row's own fix direction. Rejected: (1) a regex-capable between(), which is more code for the same result. (2) Splitting moe-agent.sh's line back in two: DoD 2 forbids touching the launchers, and every launcher edit hot-reloads every seat. (3) Re-anchoring every other boundary that ends in \n: out of scope, and each of those still matches.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: The sh decide slice now carries `; VM_TASKLESS_SKIP=false`, which the sh outcome slice reads as `[ "$VM_TASKLESS_SKIP" = true ]`. That is harmless in the fixture, which sets no VM_ROUTE. isEpicFinal:true is only the max-order fallback, because epic-be924fb8 has no finalTaskId; the gate is scoped to the red CI step, not a whole-epic regression. The architect dry-ran this exact plan: the edit applied to a clone at acea850b, with the step-2 command run from its root. It passed in 85 s (seat-registration 59 tests, 40 pass, 19 skipped, all PS 5.1; then the CI step 169 tests, 113 pass, 0 fail, 56 skipped). The same command on the unfixed file exits 1. The ps1-boundary mutant fails the new case with 'missing boundaries'.
planningNotes.risks: pwsh 7 exists on this host only as tarballs: /mnt/d/moe-scratch/pwsh/pwsh-7.6.9-linux-x64.tgz (the architect copied it from hunt #20's /tmp/hunt-9f3e/pwsh.tgz). Without pwsh the PS7 rows SKIP and the exit code stays 0, which is why the gate greps '# skipped 19'. task-1dfec7a4 (BACKLOG, the ps1 twin of 1ccae85c) will probably edit the ps1 decide line. A trailing statement there is now covered, but a second `    $moeSkipLaunch = $false` line above it would trip the count === 1 assertion, by design. task-62ec51f1 (WORKING) holds scripts/moe-agent.ps1, not this test file.
